# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_stars:0.1.0"}}. It can be placed in the world, but doesn't do anything on its own.

All {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/enclosure","plural":true}} are an intermediary recipe step that crafts other {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine","plural":true}} of its tier.

The {{"of":"self"}} can be used to craft {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier1.5","text":"tier 1.5 machines"}}.

# Upgrading

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can be directly upgraded into a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:steel_machine_enclosure"}}, giving access to {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier2","text":"tier 2 machines"}}. The crafting recipe for this involves {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_stars:steel_ingot","plural":true}}, requiring machines of at least {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier1","text":"tier 1"}}.
